title: Imported C3D10H near-incompressible periodic cell
purpose: Verify AgentFEM's quasi-incompressible finite-strain periodic-cell workflow: quadratic source geometry, P2-displacement/DG0-pressure hybrid formulation, mixed macro reference-point control, exact equation constraints, homogenization, and unified output.
physics: three-dimensional near-incompressible mixed Neo-Hookean periodic homogenization

execution.evidence: The versioned source contains 14,942 nodes and 8,781 quadratic tetrahedra. AgentFEM records the formulation identity, solves 8,781 independent DG0 pressure unknowns beside quadratic displacement, obtains the free TOP-U2 and FRONT-U3 macro responses, and writes U, PRESSURE, P, S, LE, J, MISES, SENER, F, and EVOL to one time series.

observables: The checked-in source directly declares C3D10H; no derived Abaqus mesh is required.
The conversion manifest retains C3D10H hybrid/constant-pressure identity beside tetra10 geometry.
All 4,212 Abaqus equation constraints have zero reported mismatch at accepted increments.
The converged control-node motion gives F=diag(1.2, 0.9178618773, 0.9180572899), with both transverse stretches solved rather than prescribed.
The final homogenized P22 and P33 are each below 2e-11 in magnitude, and the two transverse stretches differ by less than 2e-4.
Every accepted state has positive quadrature-point deformation Jacobian.
The mixed pressure field is a solved DG0 field and is not confused with first-Piola stress P.
The two homogenized first-Piola reconstructions agree within tolerance.
acceptance: Three automatic increments reach load factor one and every increment converges.
The direct C3D10H source retains 14,942 nodes and 8,781 tetra10 cells.
The minimum sampled J remains positive and periodic equation mismatch remains below 1e-10.
Versioned homogenized stress and volume observables satisfy the Golden tolerances.

quantities.name: homogenized_first_piola_stress
quantities.description: Row-major first-Piola tensor from a solid-volume integral normalized by the complete periodic-cell reference volume.

quantities.name: measured_macro_deformation_gradient
quantities.description: Row-major macro deformation gradient recovered from converged RIGHT/TOP/FRONT control-node displacements.

quantities.name: solid_reference_fraction
quantities.description: Versioned solid fraction of the imported porous cell.

quantities.name: minimum_quadrature_J
quantities.description: Minimum degree-four quadrature sample at final load factor.

quantities.name: periodic_equation_max_error
quantities.description: Maximum residual of the imported Abaqus equation set.

scope: Three-dimensional quasi-incompressible Neo-Hookean finite deformation with one constant pressure unknown per quadratic tetrahedron.
Serial mixed affine-periodic solution with two free transverse normal reference-point components.
The distributed constraint backend currently serves fully prescribed displacement formulations.
limitations: The mixed affine-periodic route with solved macro components is currently serial.
This benchmark covers one P2-displacement/DG0-pressure tetrahedral formulation and one matrix/void periodic cell.
Distributed mixed constraints and broader multi-material hybrid formulations remain roadmap capabilities.
